title: Get feedback from readers

stage.name: Feedback
stage.description: Trusted readers share what works and what doesn't.

intro: Other eyes see what you can't.

options: People who read a draft before publication and share their reactions
The first people to buy the book
questions.why: Beta readers show you how the book lands with real readers.

questions.prompt: What's the most useful way to receive feedback?
options: Listen, ask questions, then decide what to change
questions.why: Feedback is information. You still decide what the story needs.

questions.prompt: If several readers are confused by the same part, it's worth a close look.
questions.why: One reader's opinion is a data point. Several pointing to the same place is a pattern.

questions.prompt: Who is best to ask for advice about your relationship?
options: Trusted people who want good things for both of you
Only people who always agree with you
questions.why: Good advice comes from people who are on the side of your relationship.

talk: Whose advice about relationships do you each trust, and why?
